source_tests: historical did 2.1.2 install and exact object comparison
reason: The R source installs did 2.1.2 into a temporary library and compares current R objects against that historical R package. The Stata port cannot and should not expose a public command surface for R package-version namespace regression.
accepted_behavior: Stata verifies the corresponding current public inference surfaces: ATT(g,t) SEs, influence-function dimensions, clustered SE metadata, repeated-cross-section inference, and dynamic/group/calendar aggregation SEs.
